bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/search-colors-5a93de6"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = 5a93de671ee158205759bb6e264cd3cd48466743
test -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs"
printf 'DOCKER_STATUS='
if docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo PASS; else echo FAILED; fi
printf 'BUILD_CONTEXT_FILES='
for f in package.json pnpm-lock.yaml pnpm-workspace.yaml artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs; do test -f "$WT/$f" && printf '%s=YES ' "$f" || printf '%s=NO ' "$f"; done
echo
TMP="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$TMP"' EXIT
if docker build --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:search-color-5a93de6 "$WT" >"$TMP" 2>&1; then
 echo BUILD_STATUS=PASS
else
 rc=$?
 echo BUILD_STATUS=FAILED
 echo "BUILD_EXIT=$rc"
 python3 - "$TMP" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys,re
s=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text(errors='replace')
patterns={'DISK_FULL':r'no space left','NETWORK':r'network.*(unreachable|timeout)|connection.*(refused|reset)|i/o timeout','DNS':r'no such host|lookup .* failed','LOCKFILE':r'ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|frozen-lockfile','NODE_IMAGE':r'failed to resolve source metadata|manifest unknown|pull access denied','BUILD_CONTEXT':r'failed to calculate checksum|not found: not found','OOM':r'out of memory|killed|exit code: 137','PERMISSION':r'permission denied','PNPM':r'ERR_PNPM_|pnpm install','ESBUILD':r'esbuild|Could not resolve|✘ \[ERROR\]','DOCKER_DAEMON':r'Cannot connect to the Docker daemon','TYPE_ERROR':r'TS[0-9]{4}'}
for key,pattern in patterns.items():
 print('BUILD_DIAG_'+key+'='+('YES' if re.search(pattern,s,re.I) else 'NO'))
print('BUILD_LOG_LINES='+str(len(s.splitlines())))
print('BUILD_LAST_STEP='+str(next((m.group(1) for line in reversed(s.splitlines()) if (m:=re.search(r'^#[0-9]+ \[([^]]+)\]',line))), 'UNKNOWN'))[:100])
PY
fi
